parent_s7_v1.inheritance: All 168 cells, workload, topology, A100 40 GiB capacity, directional bandwidth, repair, policy, seed, copy, recovery, replay, and no-selection gates are inherited without relaxation.

frozen_failure_target_contract.reference_trace: One policy-free nominal trace per seed using the common workflow universe, source-rank placement, serving lanes, service model, and 90-180 s measurement cohort; no protection admission, copy, reclaim, failover, recovery, policy, direction, bandwidth, or repair treatment is present.
frozen_failure_target_contract.probe_timestamp: Twelve seed-derived equal-width stratified timestamps over [90000,180000] ms.
frozen_failure_target_contract.source_rank: At each timestamp choose uniformly from ranks with at least one nominally active measurement-cohort source task; choice occurs before any policy/treatment run.
frozen_failure_target_contract.worker_target: Sorted unique measurement-cohort workflow IDs with an active nominal task on the selected source rank.
frozen_failure_target_contract.node_target: Sorted unique measurement-cohort workflow IDs with an active nominal task on one of the eight ranks in the selected source node.
frozen_failure_target_contract.empty_target: FAIL_CLOSE without timestamp/rank resampling or outcome-bearing substitution.
frozen_failure_target_contract.identity_hash: SHA-256 canonical JSON of seed, failure_type, probe_id, timestamp_ms, source_rank, and sorted_workflow_ids.
frozen_failure_target_contract.cross_policy_treatment_gate: The reference trace, base probe tuple, target IDs, target count, and target identity hash are byte-identical across both policies and every registered treatment for each seed/failure_type/probe.
frozen_failure_target_contract.probe_metric: For the fixed target IDs, mean workflow completion_ms minus arrival_ms under healthy and same-probe fault replay; added WCT is their difference.
frozen_failure_target_contract.cell_aggregation: Equal mean over all 12 probe-level target-set means; no weighting by target-set size.
frozen_failure_target_contract.seed_statistics: Pair policies within each seed/condition; Student-t 95% CI over three paired seeds (df=2).
frozen_failure_target_contract.changed_only: Never used as a cross-policy denominator.

figure_grammar.layout: 2x3: four directional bandwidth panels and worker/node repair panels; each panel retains all-workflow primary and fixed-target secondary paired mean plus 95% CI
figure_grammar.panel_text_boundary: No preliminary, seed, hash, or evidence prose in panels; provenance remains in manifest/audit.

hard_gates: all inherited v3.1.3 capacity/copy/replay tests and S7 directional tests pass
exactly 168 cells and 2016 failure-target probe rows
all target sets are nonempty; empty set fails closed without resampling
per-probe target identity hashes are identical across policies and treatments
worker/GPU failure invalidates exactly one rank and source-node exactly its eight-rank node
all-workflow primary and fixed-target secondary metrics are both emitted
fault replay never lowers WCT under either denominator
capacity, physical target, copy, reclaim, and replay accounting conserve
all four directions, five bandwidths, four repair values, two domains, three seeds, and both policies are retained
no performance-direction, minimum-gain, sign, seed, cell, probe, or path-selection gate
single-page vector PDF, PNG width at least 1800 px, minimum extracted font at least 7 pt
selection_policy: S7_V2_NONE; no outcome-based selection is allowed.
evidence_boundary: Three-seed metadata-DES sensitivity with a policy-independent fixed-target secondary denominator. The all-workflow denominator remains primary. A100 directional bandwidth, 500 ms activation, and replacement durations remain modeled/unmeasured; Native Mooncake remains a modeled Router+Store approximation. This is not paper-ready physical evidence.
